name: vibez
description: A fast VS Code project switcher with Git Graph-inspired visuals and tmux-backed terminal restore.

vibez.codeDirectory.description: Root directory Vibez scans for projects. Immediate child folders are treated as switch targets.

vibez.recentLimit.description: Maximum number of recent projects shown ahead of the main list.

vibez.tmux.enabled.description: Use tmux sessions to preserve per-project terminal state across workspace switches.

vibez.tmux.sessionPrefix.description: Prefix used when creating tmux sessions for projects.

vibez.tmux.bootstrapCommand.description: Command sent to a newly created tmux session before first attach. Leave blank to disable bootstrapping.

vibez.switch.reuseWindow.description: Reuse the current VS Code window when switching projects.

vibez.switch.restoreTerminal.description: Attach the project's tmux session after the new workspace opens.
